summoning_descent.name: The Descent
summoning_descent.description: The Iron Cross cell's rite to call the descending god (外神) into Tingen. Each ingredient binds another thread of the gate; the final step demands the marked sacrifice.
steps: Inscribe the consecrated circle in chalk.
Set and light the candle at the circle's point.
Lay the salt wards and speak the descending name.
Offer the marked sacrifice to open the gate.

counter_rite.name: The Unbinding Rite
counter_rite._note: M28 (direction v2 §6) — the COUNTER-RITE, the ONLY player verb that pushes Doom DOWN. Consumed by the CounterRite autoload (which RitualPanel drives from a button + tests call directly). Data-driven: `ingredients` are Inventory item ids spent; `doom_reduction` is subtracted from the Doom meter; `impede` is added to SummoningPlan (a weaker descent); `notice_cost` is the Notice tax (push-your-luck — buying time draws the Beyond's eye). TUNING placeholders.
counter_rite.description: A warding rite worked against the descent — chalk, candle-smoke, and a name spoken backward. It buys the city time and turns the Beyond's eye toward you: the only rite that pushes the Doom clock BACK, paid for in Notice.
counter_rite._hint_note: M32 — the once-per-run DISCOVERABILITY hint. Surfaced diegetically (WorldState.thought_requested, the HUD's thought channel) by CounterRite the FIRST moment the player holds every ingredient this run — the single line that tells a fresh player the anti-Doom rite exists and how to reach it (the ritual panel, R). Content is DATA here, not an engine literal; no NPC-id branch.
counter_rite.hint: Consecrated chalk and a candle in your bag — the makings of an unbinding rite. Open your rituals (press R) and work it to turn the Doom clock back, if you'll pay the Beyond's notice.
steps: Draw the unbinding circle in consecrated chalk.
Light the candle and read the descending name backward.
Snuff the flame — and feel the Beyond turn to look at you.
